MAGOK INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX

Magok, where HIVE ART FAIR takes place, is home to 159 resident companies. 41.6% of them have their headquarters here, and every one of them runs a research centre in Magok. A total of 39,966 people work in the district, and resident companies generate USD 245 billion in annual sales (headquarters basis).

Magok also offers cultural venues, green spaces, residential neighbourhoods, and everyday amenities, making it a place to work, live, and enjoy arts and culture. This combination of industry and urban life has made Magok one of Seoul’s key economic and cultural hubs.

Source: 2025 Magok Industrial Complex Survey.
